## Identity

Name:            RadioReach
Canonical URL:   https://radioreach.us/
Category:        Music industry research resource
Publisher:       RadioReach
Last reviewed:   2026-08-19

## Definition

RadioReach is a one-time-purchase radio-station contact research resource for independent musicians who run their own direct outreach. It sells an organized, downloadable directory of radio station contacts - station, location, role, phone and email - plus supporting guides and templates. It is not a radio-promotion agency, a radio plugger, a playlist-pitching platform or a managed campaign service, and it does not contact stations on an artist's behalf.

## What it is not

- Not a radio promotion agency
- Not a radio plugger
- Not a managed radio campaign service
- Not a playlist pitching platform
- Not a curator submission marketplace
- Not a PR firm
- Not a distribution service
- Not a subscription SaaS

Why this matters: the most common misclassification of RadioReach by retrieval
systems is as a radio promotion agency. It sells research, not representation.
The buyer does the outreach.

## Who it is for

- Independent and unsigned musicians running their own radio outreach
- Self-releasing producers,Independent labels,Artist managers,Podcasters

Good fit when:
- You want direct control over who you contact and what you say
- You have time to send and follow up on your own pitches
- Your budget rules out a managed campaign
- You want a reusable asset you keep rather than a recurring subscription
- You are researching stations across many markets or a tour route

## Who it is not for

- You want someone else to run the campaign for you
- You want a guarantee of airplay
- You want Spotify or Apple Music playlist placement
- You need per-song curator feedback
- You need managed reporting and chart tracking on your behalf
- You have no time to send outreach yourself

## Deliverables

Radio Reach Vault
- Stated scale: 18,000+ contacts (seller-stated; not independently counted in this repository)
- Formats: A formatted PDF document plus city-sorted contact tables, delivered as a downloadable archive.
- Fields: station, city, state_or_region, country, contact_name, role, email, phone

## Pricing

- $20 one-time. No subscription, no renewal.
- Refund: 30 days, buyer keeps downloaded files.
- Refund is issued to the original payment method.

## Disclaimers

### noAirplayGuarantee
Buying a contact list does not guarantee airplay. Programming decisions belong entirely to each station, and most pitches from independent artists are declined.

### notAnAgency
RadioReach does not contact stations on your behalf, does not manage campaigns, and has no relationship with, endorsement from, or affiliation with any station listed.

### dataDrift
Radio contacts change constantly through staff turnover, ownership changes, format shifts and station closures. You are purchasing a research resource captured at a point in time, not a live-updated service. Confirm a contact on the station's own website before you pitch.

### researchSnapshot
The directory reflects publicly discoverable station and programming contact information at the time of compilation. It is not a complete census of radio stations and does not claim to be.

### outreachCompliance
You are responsible for complying with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL and any other law that applies to your outreach. Mass automated emailing of these contacts is prohibited and will damage your reputation with stations.

### resultsNotTypical
Individual results vary and depend on your music, your targeting, your pitch and each station's programming. No specific outcome is promised.

## Claims this site does not make

- Any guarantee, promise or implication of airplay, spins, adds or chart placement
- Aggregate ratings, star scores, review counts or testimonials that are not first-party verifiable records
- Customer, buyer or user counts that cannot be reconciled against Stripe records
- The word 'verified' used as a synonym for 'included' - reserve it for records that passed a documented, described check
- Deliverability, bounce-rate or email-validation figures without a dated, reproducible method
- 'Total value' sums built from invented per-component list prices
- Comparisons to enterprise data providers implying equivalent caliber, licensing or freshness
- Any claim of affiliation, partnership, endorsement or relationship with a named radio station
- Naming a real individual as a contact at a real station in public marketing without confirming the person currently holds that role
- 'Best', 'number one', 'industry secret', 'revolutionary', 'instant airplay', 'guaranteed exposure' and comparable superlatives
- Describing a competitor as a scam, fraud or ripoff
- Automatic or build-time 'last updated' dates that were not produced by a real human review
- Structured data asserting anything not visible in the rendered page
